blurb: Goremonger kill teams are territorial and aggressive, yet to view them as crazed butchers would be an oversimplification. They strive to emulate the bladework and military discipline of a Bloodletter pack, and are capable of identifying and destroying strategic assets in order to achieve victory in Khorne's name.
lore: Khorne does not care about objectives, ground or the outcome of the war, and neither, in the end, do these. A Goremonger warband is a group of World Eaters and aspirants held together by the Butcher's Nails and a shared understanding that the only thing worse than the fighting is the interval between fights. They will take the objective if the objective has people standing on it.

source.notes: Operative stats, weapon profiles, actions, ploys and equipment transcribed from Wahapedia. Ranged weapons without a printed Range rule are given range 48 (effectively unlimited on a Kill Team board). Consult the official source for the current rules: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/downloads/kill-team/

selectionRules: 7 GOREMONGER operatives selected from the following list: ASPIRANT; BLOODTAKER; IMPALER; INCITER; SKULLCLAIMER; STALKER

operatives.name: Goremonger Blood Herald
operatives.lore: He still gives orders, which for a World Eater is a considerable achievement, and he gives them in the narrowing window before the Nails take the rest of the sentence.

operatives.name: Goremonger Aspirant
operatives.lore: Not yet implanted, and desperate to be. He fights recklessly to be noticed, which is the point of the audition.

operatives.name: Goremonger Bloodtaker
operatives.lore: He counts, and the count is the whole of his private theology. Interrupting him is unwise.

abilities.name: TRANSFUSION RITUAL
abilities.description: Decrease this operative's GORE TANK. Instead of using a SANGUAVITAE rule, you can increase the GORE TANK of one other friendly GOREMONGER operative within 8" of this operative. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if its GORE TANK is empty.

operatives.name: Goremonger Impaler
operatives.lore: Chain-axe and reach. He pins what he catches and works at his leisure, which is not long.

abilities.name: GORE-FUEL
abilities.description: Decrease this operative's GORE TANK. Until this operative uses any profile of its fleshskewer, all profiles of it have the Severe weapon rule. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if its GORE TANK is empty.

operatives.name: Goremonger Inciter
operatives.lore: He drives the warband forward by making the alternative intolerable, and is uncomfortably good at finding what each of them cannot stand.

abilities.name: DASH AND SPRAY
abilities.description: Perform a free Dash action and a free Shoot action with this operative in any order. You can only select dual autopistols (focused) for that Shoot action. This operative cannot perform this action while it has a Conceal order, or while within control range of an enemy operative.Incite the Hunt: Whenever this operative incapacitates an enemy operative from more than 2" away, before that enemy operative is removed from the killzone, you can increase the GORE TANK of one friendly GOREMONGER operative within 8" of that enemy operative. Whenever this operative inflicts damage on an enemy operative with either profile of its dual autopistols but doesn't incapacitate it, that enemy operative gains one of your Bleeding tokens (if it doesn't already have one). During a friendly GOREMONGER operative's activation or counteraction, before or after it performs an action, if it's within 8" of an enemy operative that has one of your Bleeding tokens, you can remove that token and increase that friendly operative's GORE TANK.

operatives.name: Goremonger Skullclaimer
operatives.lore: The trophies are not decorative and not optional. He will break formation, position and sense to take one.

operatives.name: Goremonger Stalker
operatives.lore: The Nails have left him quiet rather than loud, which the others find more disturbing. He arrives without announcement.

factionRules.name: Runes of Khorne
factionRules.description: Each friendly GOREMONGER operative cannot lose more than 8 wounds per Shoot action.

factionRules.name: Gore Tanks
factionRules.description: Each friendly GOREMONGER operative has a GORE TANK that has three levels: full, half and empty. They start the battle at half. Whenever a GORE TANK increases, it goes up one level; whenever it decreases, it goes down one level. A GORE TANK cannot increase when it's already full, or decrease when it's already empty (see diagram on other side). Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative incapacitates an operative within its control range, or visible to and within 2" of it, you can increase its GORE TANK. Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative uses a SANGUAVITAE rule, you must decrease its GORE TANK.

factionRules.name: Sanguavitae
factionRules.description: Each SANGUAVITAE rule specifies when it can be used, and you must decrease the operative's GORE TANK to do so. You cannot use the same SANGUAVITAE rule more than once per activation or counteraction, and you cannot use more than two SANGUAVITAE rules per activation or counteraction. You cannot use Mania and Fury during the same activation. RejuvenateWHEN: During a friendly GOREMONGER operative's activation or counteraction, before or after it performs an action. EFFECT: That operative regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.ManiaWHEN: During a friendly GOREMONGER operative's activation, before or after it performs an action. EFFECT: Until the start of that operative's next activation, add 1 to its APL stat.FuryWHEN: During a friendly GOREMONGER operative's activation, before or after it performs an action. EFFECT: That operative can perform two Fight actions during that activation, and the second one is free.RakeWHEN: When a friendly GOREMONGER operative performs the Charge action during its activation. EFFECT: When that operative finishes moving during that action, you can inflict D3 damage on one enemy operative within its control range.SurgeWHEN: When a friendly GOREMONGER operative performs the Charge or Reposition action. EFFECT: Until the end of that action, add 1" to that operative's Move stat.RageWHEN: When a friendly GOREMONGER operative performs the Fight action. EFFECT: Until the end of that action, add 1 to the Atk stat of that operative's melee weapons.

strategicPloys.name: ENHANCED VIOLENCE
strategicPloys.description: Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative's GORE TANK is: Half, its melee weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.Full, its melee weapons have the Relentless weapon rule.

hooks.notes: GORE TANK is not simulated; the Half-tank reading is used

strategicPloys.name: AUGMENTED ENDURANCE
strategicPloys.description: Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly GOREMONGER operative, if that friendly operative's GORE TANK is: Half, you can re-roll one of your defence dice.Full, you can re-roll any of your defence dice.

hooks.notes: GORE TANK is not simulated; the Half-tank reading is used

strategicPloys.name: GORY TENACITY
strategicPloys.description: Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative is fighting or retaliating, the first time your opponent strikes it during that sequence, halve the damage inflicted (rounding up and to a minimum of 2).

hooks.notes: printed as halving the first strike of each fight; simulated as 2 damage off every melee hit

strategicPloys.name: HUNT FOR BLOOD
strategicPloys.description: Select one friendly GOREMONGER operative. If it has a Conceal order, change it to Engage. Then it can immediately perform a free Charge action, but cannot move more than 3" during that action.

hooks.notes: printed as one immediate 3" charge by a nominated operative; simulated as a free Charge for each operative that activates this turning point

firefightPloys.name: UNBRIDLED AGGRESSION
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly GOREMONGER operative is fighting during an activation in which it performed the Charge action, at the end of the Roll Attack Dice step. Until the end of that sequence, that operative's melee weapons have the Severe weapon rule.

firefightPloys.name: GORETHIRST
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when you would counteract. You can do so with one friendly GOREMONGER operative that has a Conceal order, but before it counteracts, you must change its order to Engage and it cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Shoot or Fight during that counteraction.

firefightPloys.name: DESTRUCTIVE DEMISE
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly GOREMONGER operative is incapacitated, before it's removed from the killzone. Inflict damage determined by that friendly operative's GORE TANK on one enemy operative within that friendly operative's control range. Inflict: D3 if empty.D3+1 if half.D3+2 if full.

hooks.notes: the amount is fixed at the half-full GORE TANK value (D3+1) rather than read off the tank the operative died with

firefightPloys.name: LACERATE FLESH
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly GOREMONGER operative with an empty GORE TANK is activated or counteracts. Increase that operative's GORE TANK. At the end of that activation/counteraction, decrease its GORE TANK (you cannot use this decrease to use a SANGUAVITAE rule); if you cannot decrease its GORE TANK, inflict D3 damage on it.

equipment.name: GORY TOTEM
equipment.description: Before the battle, you can set up one of your Gory Totem markers wholly within your territory and more than 2" from other markers (excluding your Bloody Cadaver marker). Whenever an enemy operative within 3" of your Gory Totem marker is shooting, fighting or retaliating, your opponent cannot re-roll their attack dice.

equipment.name: BLOODY CADAVER
equipment.description: Before the battle, you can set up one of your Bloody Cadaver markers wholly within your territory and more than 2" from other markers (excluding your Gory Totem marker). Friendly GOREMONGER operatives can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker. In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, you can increase the GORE TANK of one friendly GOREMONGER operative that controls that marker, unless that friendly operative is within control range of an enemy operative.

equipment.name: CHAOS SIGIL
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when an operative is shooting a friendly GOREMONGER operative, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step, you can use this rule. If you do, worsen the x of the Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any) until the end of that sequence. Note that Piercing 1 would therefore be ignored.

equipment.name: WRIST CHAINS
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when a friendly GOREMONGER operative performs the Shoot action and you're selecting a ranged weapon, you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of that action, the following melee weapons are treated as ranged weapons with the Range 2" weapon rule: chainblade, chainglaive, great chainaxe (ignore its Brutal weapon rule), pickrippers. If that melee weapon has the Balanced or Relentless weapon rules as a result of the Enhanced Violence strategy ploy, it has those weapon rules while it is a ranged weapon.

ritual.text: Whenever this operative is using this weapon, the first time you inflict damage on an operative within its control range during that sequence, you can increase this operative's GORE TANK.

drag.text: Whenever this operative is shooting with this weapon, at the start of the Resolve Attack Dice step (before inflicting damage), you can move the target up to x". X is your total number of successful unblocked attack dice, multiplied by 2. The target must be moved to a location it can be placed as close as possible to this operative. Then you can discard any of your successful unblocked attack dice.
drag.notes: the engine always drags the full distance and never discards attack dice to spare the target
